column3: The finance office will move to the third floor on Monday. Staff are asked to affirm their new desk numbers by Friday so that the re­lo­ca­tion can flow smoothly. An efficient workflow depends on clear labels for every box.

The fa­cil­i­ties team has confirmed that the official floor plan is final. Please file any complaint about misplaced equip­ment with the help desk. Coffee will be served in the lounge on the fifth floor during the tran­si­tion. The move co­or­di­na­tor will send a short sum­ma­ry every evening.
